epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the successful search retrieval rate of relevant protocols to 95%
requirements: R1: Investigate and categorize the newly detected pattern of design review concerns in the protocol search implementation
R2: Patch the existing code directly to assign a concrete rootCausePatternId to the uncategorized defect events
R3: Verify the patch with targeted tests to ensure the new rootCausePatternId is correctly recorded without causing regressions

slices.title: Assign rootCausePatternId to search defect events
slices.jtbd: When implementing the defect classification for this epic, I want to assign a concrete rootCausePatternId to the uncategorized search review concerns, so that the anomaly is resolved and tracked correctly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the unclassified design review concerns in stream 'reviewConcerns'
When the patch assigns the new rootCausePatternId in the existing code
Then the stream's u-chart centerline returns to 0.0000
Given the need for testing
When running unit tests
Then the tests verify that rootCausePatternId is properly applied to the events.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce uncategorized design review concerns in stream 'reviewConcerns' from u=0.1000 to 0.0000
